title: Airport dropdown flickers when showing results, preventing selection
body: The airport selection dropdown flickers rapidly when displaying search results, making it impossible to select any airport.
author: doctorase

comments.body:
This was a problem a few versions back.

 Can you tell me your surmai version and browser version please?

First it appeared with sumai version 0.0.3, then I changed to version 0.1.0 and the error persisted. 
The browser I use is mozilla on both desktop pc and android, the same error in the latest version.

 

Now I have tried again and it works without problems, I do not know what has changed.

title: [FEAT REQUEST] List all trips in date order
body:
Trips that we create are being listed based on the date creation and not date trip.
It would be better if it's listed by trip dates or a setting where we can chose the way it's listed.
author: edersong

comments.body: The dashboard in general needs some redesigning. it may be possible to include a custom sorting option.

title: Purpose of email settings?
body: I can't ever get the test email to work in the main interface. I did get the settings to work by going to pocket base and testing them from there. I don't ever get any emails other than the test emails from the pb interface. Are there supposed to be emails sent when logged in, account creation, or anything else? I don't know if my setup is broken or if the email feature just isn't used yet.
author: erocm123

comments.body: The email feature isn't really used for anything yet. You will get password reset emails etc but that's about it
